g.text: PLAN VIEW - BWB FORWARD FUSELAGE WITH H₂ INTEGRATION
1. All dimensions in millimeters unless noted
4. Cryogenic H₂ tank design per EASA CS-25 and applicable hydrogen safety standards
5. BWB planform with hyperbolic wing curvature (see contour lines)
6. Emergency egress paths per CS-25.807 / FAR 25.807 requirements
7. Firewall bulkheads per CS-25.857 / FAR 25.857 (fire protection)
8. Curved pressure shells follow BWB outer mold line
